en.headline: Police arrest 10 for dangerous driving after first drone operation on Kwun Tong Bypass
en.dek: Nine men and a woman aged 25 to 51 were detained between 3 and 10 August; officers seized seven private cars and three motorcycles in the East Kowloon operation.
body: Police arrested ten drivers suspected of dangerous driving after deploying drones for the first time in a targeted enforcement operation along the Kwun Tong Bypass.

The Kowloon East traffic unit ran the eight-day operation code-named Fastshield from 3 to 10 August. Nine men and one woman, all local residents aged between 25 and 51, were arrested. Seven private cars and three motorcycles were impounded for examination.

Senior Inspector Pun Chun-ho of the Traffic Kowloon East enforcement and control division said some of those arrested had driven at extreme speeds, weaving recklessly through traffic. One vehicle was recorded travelling at about 180 km/h on a stretch limited to 70-80 km/h.

Officers used a drone for high-altitude observation and evidence gathering, coordinated with unmarked high-performance vehicles stationed at strategic points. Police said the aerial footage would strengthen prosecutions and that the approach reduced the manpower required. Dangerous driving carries a maximum penalty of a HK$25,000 fine and three years’ imprisonment, plus a minimum six-month driving ban.

zh.headline: 警首次用無人機打擊觀塘繞道危駕 拘10人扣10車
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部3日至10日行動中，9男1女年齡25至51歲涉危險駕駛被捕，扣留7輛私家車及3輛電單車。
body: 警方東九龍總區交通部於本月3日至10日在觀塘繞道一帶展開代號「飛盾」執法行動，重點打擊危險駕駛，首次運用無人機進行高空觀察及搜證，配合隱形戰車執法，合共拘捕10名司機。
被捕者為9男1女本地人，年齡介乎25至51歲，涉嫌危險駕駛。行動中扣留7輛私家車及3輛電單車作進一步檢驗。
東九龍總區交通部執行及管制組特遣隊高級督察潘俊豪表示，有被捕司機曾以極端速度在高速公路上左穿右插，險象環生。其中一輛私家車曾在限速每小時70至80公里路段以約180公里高速行駛。
警方利用無人機靈活性高、覆蓋面廣的優勢進行高空觀察及指揮，並調派預先部署的隱形戰車尾隨目標車輛搜證執法。無人機拍攝的違法過程可用作搜證，加強舉證力度，同時節省大量人手。危險駕駛最高可處罰款2.5萬元及監禁3年，違例司機至少停牌6個月。
